data_privacy_modal_intro: Khartis is a project of the Atelier de cartographie at Sciences Po.
data_privacy_modal_privacy_local: Khartis runs entirely in your browser. The data you import — tables, geographic files, place names, join results — is never sent to a server: all processing happens locally and stays stored on your device.
data_privacy_modal_privacy_analytics: Khartis uses Google Analytics for audience analytics, which you can decline. No cartographic data or imported content is collected.
data_privacy_modal_privacy_remote: Some basemaps or external resources may be loaded directly from the internet by your browser.
data_privacy_modal_privacy_dpo: For any question about how your data is handled or to exercise your rights, you can contact the Data Protection Officer (DPO) of Sciences Po at:
data_privacy_modal_legal_publisher_value: Sciences Po (the Fondation Nationale des Sciences Politiques and the Institut d'Études Politiques de Paris), Atelier de cartographie.
data_privacy_modal_legal_director_value: The Administrator of the FNSP and Director of the Institut d'Études Politiques de Paris (Sciences Po).
data_privacy_modal_legal_host_value: Sciences Po – Direction du numérique (Dnum). Address: 27, rue Saint-Guillaume, 75337 Paris Cedex 07, France.
data_privacy_modal_team_oss_value: Thomas Ansart (Atelier de cartographie). The application relies on standalone software libraries developed within the Atelier: geoarrow-deck-stream, motif.js, ok-palette and proj-suggest.
data_privacy_modal_license_software_text: The source code of this application is open and distributed under the MIT license. You can review it, install it locally or contribute to it on our
data_privacy_modal_license_data_value: The sources and copyright notices specific to each basemap are shown when you select them in the application and are automatically included in the layout of the maps you generate.

sidenav_install_help_ios_step_3: Confirm the addition to install Khartis on your device.
sidenav_install_help_chromium_step_1: On a computer, look for the installation icon in the address bar.
sidenav_install_help_chromium_step_2: On Android mobile, the option may also appear as 'Add to Home Screen'.
sidenav_install_help_safari_mac_step_2: Choose 'Add to Dock' when the option is available.
sidenav_install_help_safari_mac_step_3: Then validate the installation to open Khartis as an application.
sidenav_install_help_firefox_step_1: On Android, open the menu then use the installation or add to home screen option.
sidenav_install_help_firefox_step_2: On iPhone or iPad, use the Share menu then 'Add to Home Screen'.
sidenav_install_help_firefox_step_3: On a computer, Firefox does not offer the classic PWA installation. Use Chrome, Edge or Safari instead to install Khartis.
sidenav_install_help_opera_step_2: Look for 'Install application', 'Install' or 'Add to Home Screen'.
sidenav_install_help_opera_step_3: If the option does not appear, try from Chrome, Edge or Safari.
sidenav_install_help_other_step_1: Look for an installation icon in the address bar or a dedicated entry in the browser menu.
sidenav_install_help_other_step_2: When no installation option is offered, the browser probably does not support PWA installation of Khartis.
sidenav_install_help_other_note: In this case, preferably use Chrome, Edge or Safari to install the application.

discretization_desc_kmeans: Creates natural thresholds with the K-means SQL method.
